logo_override.alt_text: Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development
logo_override.validation_detail: webfetch returned 'Image fetched successfully', which per the brief confirms HTTP 200 plus a real image content type rather than a WAF interstitial or HTML error page. Declared by the site itself in Yoast JSON-LD as width 321 x height 346. The asset was decoded and rendered for inspection: a full-colour geometric crest in green/teal/blue on a white field, with no transparency and no white-on-transparent wordmark, so it is legible on a light card. Byte size could not be measured a second way because raw HttpWebRequest to this host is refused with HTTP 403 by the site's WAF even with browser User-Agent/Referer/Accept headers; the webfetch confirmation and the successful render are the verification.
logo_override._award: Arab Fund Fellowship for Academic Excellence

notes: Found the mark from the awarding body's own homepage markup rather than by guessing paths. www.arabfund.org serves Yoast SEO JSON-LD whose Organization node names 'Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development' (the AFESD fellowship-awarding body, rule 2 satisfied) and points its 'logo' property at https://www.arabfund.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Logo-1ldpi-Copy.png with caption 'Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development' - this is the site's own authoritative logo declaration, i.e. the mark the organisation itself publishes as its logo, served from its own wp-content uploads on the same registrable domain (rule 1 satisfied). Rejected og:image = https://www.arabfund.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/project-management.svg: that is programme/thematic artwork, not the corporate mark, so it is the wrong asset for a fellowship card. Probed and rejected: /favicon.ico HTTP 404, /apple-touch-icon.png HTTP 404, /en HTTP 404. Note the record's stored official_source_url https://www.arabfund.org/overview/fellowships-program timed out on three separate fetches (default and timeout=120), and https://arabfund.org/overview/fellowships-program also timed out; other paths on the same host answer normally, so this is a slow or blocked path rather than a dead host. That does not affect this shard - the logo comes from the homepage, so page_url is recorded as the homepage where the logo is actually declared.
